name: Manager for Cloudflare Zaraz
author: MatterWP

sections.description:
Manager for Cloudflare Zaraz provides a simple interface to control Cloudflare Zaraz functionality on your WordPress website, allowing you to easily enable/disable Zaraz and configure its behavior for different user types. While the plugin requires manual configuration of the Zaraz script (detailed instructions available in the Cloudflare Zaraz documentation), this approach offers significant advantages for WordPress users focused on maintaining clean analytics data.

By default, Cloudflare’s automatic Zaraz injection loads on all pages – including wp-admin – and tracks all users regardless of their login status. This can lead to skewed analytics data and unnecessary performance overhead. Our plugin addresses these limitations by giving you precise control over Zaraz’s loading behavior. Through manual configuration and our intuitive interface, you can ensure Zaraz only loads where and when you want it to, automatically excluding internal traffic from administrators and logged-in users. This results in more accurate visitor insights while preserving all the powerful third-party script management capabilities that make Zaraz valuable.

Features

  • Enable/disable Zaraz functionality
  • Option to disable Zaraz for logged-in users
  • Clean and intuitive settings interface
  • Lightweight and optimized performance

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.3.5 or higher
  • A Cloudflare account with Zaraz enabled

Languages Available

  • 🇺🇸 English (Default)
  • 🇮🇹 Italian (it_IT)
  • 🇫🇷 French (fr_FR)
  • 🇩🇪 German (de_DE)
  • 🇳🇱 Dutch (nl_NL)
  • 🇷🇺 Russian (ru_RU)
  • 🇪🇸 Spanish (es_ES)
  • 🇯🇵 Japanese (ja_JP)
  • 🇮🇳 Hindi (hi_IN)
  • 📝 POT file available for translations

Additional Information

For more information about Cloudflare Zaraz, please visit the Zaraz documentation.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloudflare.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/manager-for-cloudflare-zaraz directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->Manager for Cloudflare Zaraz screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
What is Cloudflare Zaraz?

Cloudflare Zaraz is a third-party manager that helps you load third-party tools and services on your website efficiently and securely.

Does this plugin require Cloudflare?

Yes, your domain needs to be proxied through Cloudflare and have Zaraz enabled in your Cloudflare dashboard.

Will this affect my site’s performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and only adds minimal overhead to your WordPress installation.
